sets.relationshipLabel: component part to the whole it belongs to
sets.explanation: A wheel is a functional piece of a bicycle, just as a keyboard is a functional piece of a laptop — each part serves the larger machine it belongs to.

sets.relationshipLabel: animal standing for the abstract concept it represents
sets.explanation: A dove has long stood for peace and an owl for wisdom — each animal is shorthand for the human idea it's come to symbolize.

sets.relationshipLabel: transactional role reversed into its counterpart role
sets.explanation: A buyer implies a seller and a debtor implies a creditor — each pair names the two opposing sides of the same exchange.

sets.relationshipLabel: active role reversed into the passive counterpart it acts upon
sets.explanation: A predator acts upon its prey and a teacher acts upon a student — each first word names the actor whose role only makes sense against the second word's reciprocal role.
